taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kenpoly-sec-school-field (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1874 | 2.78 | 2.78
2 | 2428 | 9.13 | 11.9
3 | 1071 | 15.2 | 27.1
4 | 3706 | 32.2 | 59.3
5 | 178 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AAK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kenpoly-sec-school-field (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AAK
Aquifer depth: >59.3 m (from the base of Layer 4 downward into the low‑resistivity Layer 5)
Recommendation: Plan the borehole to penetrate beyond 59.3 m to intersect the low‑resistivity (178 Ω·m) saturated zone identified as the main aquifer; install adequate casing through the overlying high‑resistivity layers (down to ~59.3 m) to prevent collapse and to isolate the target aquifer for clean water production.
